source: 8558G电控使用说明书英文版 (ZB-F4 Electronic Control Manual Book, 5 pages)
note: The 8558G machine uses the ZB-F4 electronic control box. The ZB-F4 is a simple mechanical-style controller with a 7-segment LED display and two buttons (+/-). For full ZB-F4 controller details, see ZB-F4.json.

panel.display: 2-digit 7-segment LED. Shows speed (e.g. 35 = 3500 rpm), error codes (E1, E2...), 'P' for parameter mode, 'ok' for success, 'Er' for failure

buttons.name: + (plus)
functions: Short press: increase speed by 100 rpm
Hold 3s in P mode: enter needle position adjust (display shows upper or lower position)
Press when error shown: attempt error recovery

buttons.name: - (minus)
functions: Short press: decrease speed by 100 rpm
Hold 3s in P mode: restore factory defaults (display shows 'ok' if success, 'Er' if fail)
Hold 3s when E5 shown: disable needle stop function

operations.speedAdjust: Panel shows 'P'. Press + or - to adjust speed. Value saved after 3 seconds. Example: 35 displayed = 3500 rpm.
operations.needlePositionAdjust: Panel shows 'P', press + for 3 seconds, then adjust up/down needle stop position.
operations.factoryReset: Panel shows 'P', press - for 3 seconds. 'ok' = success. 'Er' = failure (check other causes).
operations.errorRecovery: When error code shows, press + to attempt recovery. If error clears, returns to P. If not, error code remains.

errorCodes.description: Sleep mode — machine has been in standby for ~30 minutes and entered sleep mode, or voltage is too low
errorCodes.solution: Press + or - to wake the machine. If '0F' remains, check voltage.

errorCodes.description: Motor stuck or motor plug loose/disconnected
errorCodes.solution: 1) Motor used too much — restart after several minutes. 2) Check if fabric is too heavy. 3) Check machine lacks oil. 4) Check if plug is loose or dropped.
1) Usually caused by overuse or IGBT problem. Restart. 2) If restart fails, contact agent to replace. 3) Check plug loose or dropped.
Check if plug is connected well, coder wire is broken, or plug is loose/deformed.
1) Check plug connected well. 2) Check if Hall sensor problem. 3) If E5 is due to Hall problem, press - for 3 seconds to turn off needle stop function.
1) Check if plug is connected. 2) Check if coder wire is broken.

errorCodes.description: Machine head protection of safety switch triggered
errorCodes.solution: Check machine head is steady. User can turn off this function by pressing - for 3 seconds (before changing from agent).
Cut power immediately. Check if supply voltage exceeds 264V. Adjust voltage to rated value (220V) or change parameter Y to 0.
Cut power immediately. Check if supply voltage is under 154V. Adjust voltage to rated value (220V) or change parameter Y to 0.

troubleshooting.issue: No reaction when turning on power control box
troubleshooting.cause: Power plug not connected, fuse burnt
troubleshooting.solution: Check if power plug is connected to socket tightly. If fuse is burnt, open control box cover, locate and replace fuse with same specification.

troubleshooting.issue: Control box connected but motor doesn't work when pressing pedal
troubleshooting.cause: Speed controller plug not connected or speed controller broken
troubleshooting.solution: Check if plug of speed controller is connected to socket in control box correctly. Check if speed controller is broken.

troubleshooting.cause: Position of magnetic steel coil changed
troubleshooting.solution: Open the speed governor. Adjust position of plastic rocker arm so magnetic steel coil in rocker arm is on the Hall sensor. If motor still runs, adjust rocker arm clockwise.
Replace with same specification fuse. If problem persists, contact local agent.
